description: Defines an abstract class 'Overlay' for rendering overlays in Android Studio, including methods for painting, hiding, and setting screen clips, with dependencies on device configuration and rendering utilities.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: An abstract class representing a rendering overlay with visibility control, painting, and clipping functionalities.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources held by the overlay.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Paints the overlay onto a component using Graphics2D.

methods.name: isHiding
methods.description: Returns whether the overlay is hidden.

methods.name: paintOverlays
methods.description: Utility method to paint all overlays in a container.

methods.name: setScreenClip
methods.description: Sets a screen clip shape for the overlay based on device configuration.
